summary: Learn to design and prototype a no-code AI agent with n8n, RAG, and function calling. Build your first workflow in 5 days.
lede: No-code AI agent training teaches professionals to scope and build a practical agent workflow without writing code. For operations, analysis, automation, and product roles, it covers use-case selection, prompt design, n8n workflow setup, tool use, human review, and prototype testing, including guardrails, exception handling, and a deployment checklist.
audienceIntro: This course is built for professionals who need to design a first AI agent without writing code, while keeping the workflow practical, testable, and aligned to business operations.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: basic familiarity with business processes, digital tools, and spreadsheet-style logic. No coding or programming is required, but you should be comfortable following process steps, drafting prompts, and working with browser-based automation tools such as n8n. A laptop, stable internet access, and access to sample workflow materials are recommended for the hands-on labs.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
